text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You mean birthdays rock, yeah? I<n>think I'm starting
to get the hang of<n>your "marvelous" usage...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, we're having a sleepover<n>party in
Marvey's room!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know you're saying that it's gonna<n>be super
exciting, but don't forget<n>that your room is also my
room.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I haven't heard anything about a<n>sleepover party.
Are you guys gonna<n>make a racket the entire night?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... D-don't give me those puppy<n>eyes... All right,
fine, you can have<n>your sleepover!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, I know you love me... And<n>I'm grateful for
it.
